scope: Theorem 1.1 (Zero-plane rigidity) of the manuscript “Zero-Plane Rigidity for Einstein Four-Manifolds” (preprints/Zero-Plane-Rigidity-for-Einstein-Four-Manifolds-October-4-2026/einstein-boundary.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 348 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35a3ab1d3d2458b5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (M4, g) be a connected smooth closed Riemannian manifold satisfying Ricg = 3g, Kg(σ) ≥ 0 for every tangent two-plane σ. If Kg(σ0) = 0 for at least one tangent two-plane, then the universal Riemannian cover is isometric to S2 (1/ √ 3) × S2 (1/ √ 3) with its product metric. In particular, the tangent bundle of the universal cover is the orthogonal sum of two parallel rank-two subbundles.
